mechanisms: same runtime+reason unknown knowledge observation written once; duplicate running receipt skipped
per-owner reconcile coalesced into one microtask with a preserved skip set
catalog walks coalesced per owner; timeout bounds the wait, not the host projection build; late success publishes membership; 30 s retry cooldown
worktree cold replay moved off the first snapshot read
history capture watermarked by window operation revision; history row lookup indexed; empty captures skipped

hidden-tab client polling backed off to at least 30 s

review.independentReview: This release removes event-driven write amplification and read-path cold work without changing S/T semantics, execution admission or business records. Knowledge observations are deduplicated by fact, managed running receipts by lease state, per-owner reconciles and catalog walks are coalesced, timed-out catalog builds are allowed to finish and publish late, worktree session-fact replay is backgrounded, history capture is watermarked, cached Session views are pruned and hidden-tab polling backs off. Measured on 2000 live descendants: the next injected snapshot after 200 status edges fell from 917.7 ms to 24 ms, the first read from 1690 ms to 13.4 ms, 20 catalog events from 20 walks to 2, and a 400-edge status storm from 111.8 ms to 8.6 ms while warm reads stayed at about 0.6 ms. The six-host isolated gate, canonical/rc.2/dual-root/no-root suites and the exact 27-test same-archive matrix all pass.
